title: Reciprocal sliding transfer
summary: Each arm holds a level scoop, a shallow square tray that is open on the side facing the other arm. A cube on a very slippery surface starts on the left scoop. Without tilting the scoops, the left arm must make the cube slide out over its open edge onto the right scoop, where the cube has to come to rest. The right arm then carries it to a new place and makes it slide back onto the left scoop, where it must come to rest again. Finally the cube must be set down on a fixed output platform and left there at rest. Until that final deposit begins, the scoops may not tilt by more than 2.1 deg, and the cube may never be without scoop contact for more than about a tenth of a second.
robot_setup: Two Pandas facing each other along x. panda-0 (left): base at (-0.55, -0.22, 0), yaw 0 (facing +x). panda-1 (right): base at (0.74, 0.22, 0), yaw pi (facing -x). Each hand carries a scoop: a square tray with a 5 mm floor, inside 0.16 x 0.16 m (2 x `tool_half`, 0.08 at this instance). It has 25 mm high, 5 mm thick walls on three sides and no wall on its tool +x side, the side pointing away from the arm's own base. The tool frame is the centre of the inside floor surface, z up, x toward the open side. With the scoop level the hand points straight down and the scoop's floor centre is 0.12 m ahead of the gripper TCP along tool x and 0.04 m below it. The grey adapter enters at the middle of the back (tool -x) wall: a 12 mm wide post protrudes 6 mm inward from floor level up to 35 mm, and a bar protrudes 12 mm inward 29-41 mm above the floor, above the wall top. Start: left floor centre at (-0.015, -0.04, 0.19), level, axes aligned with the world (open side facing +x). Right floor centre at (0.175, -0.04, 0.187), level, rotated 180 deg about z (open side facing -x). The two open edges thus face each other across a gap of about 2 cm, with the right floor 3 mm lower. Role labels per phase (left, right): left_inertial_slip: inertial_donor, matched_receiver; right_receive_and_brake: cleared_donor, braking_receiver; reverse_geometry: preparing_receiver, loaded_carrier; left_receive_and_brake: braking_receiver, inertial_donor; final_support_deposit: deliverer, cleared_partner.
scene: An orange cube (36 mm edge) starts resting flat on the left scoop's floor, off the floor centre toward the open edge. Contact between the cube and the scoops is very slippery. The output platform is a fixed orange slab (0.20 x 0.15 m, 24 mm thick) on two grey posts, standing beside the scoops' working area on the -y side, toward the right arm. Nothing moves by itself. The table top is the world's z = 0 plane.
scene_privileged: Cube: half extent 0.018 m, mass `object_mass` = 0.035 kg, friction `friction` = 0.05, restitution 0.05. At reset it is placed at rest, unrotated, at the left tool frame's actual position + (0.040, dy, 0.0185) (a world-frame offset), with dy ~ U(-0.004, 0.004) (the only random draw; nothing is drawn later). It thus starts 0.5 mm above the floor, 40 mm from the floor centre toward the open edge. The local start offset (0.040, dy, 0.0185) is kept for left_inertial_slip. Scoops: friction `tool_friction` = 0.05, mass `tool_mass` = 0.2 kg, restitution 0.05. Output platform: static box 'output' with half extents (0.10, 0.075, 0.012) centred at (0.18, -0.22, 0.118) (top surface at z = 0.13), friction 0.4, restitution 0.05, two support posts underneath. Table friction `table_friction` = 0.08. `radius`, `incoming_speed`, `fixture_speed`, `preview`, `restitution`, `target_offset` and `target_tolerance` are not used by this task. Horizon `horizon` = 25 s.

phases.name: left_inertial_slip
phases.text: while the cube is on the left scoop (it has touched that tool link within the last 25 ms), its centre has moved more than 0.028 m toward the open edge from its start offset, measured along the left scoop's tool x axis (left-tool-frame x > 0.040 + 0.028 = 0.068 m).

phases.name: right_receive_and_brake
phases.text: the cube is on the right scoop (touched within the last 25 ms) and not on the left one (no left-scoop contact within the last 25 ms), for 0.3 s without interruption. During that time its centre is within 0.065 m of the right scoop's floor centre along both tool x and tool y (|x|, |y| < 0.065 m in the right tool frame), and it moves at less than 0.05 m/s relative to the right scoop (the scoop's rigid-body velocity at the cube's position). The right tool frame's position at the moment this phase completes is recorded as the receive pose.

phases.name: reverse_geometry
phases.text: with the cube on the right scoop (touched within the last 25 ms), the right tool frame is more than 0.06 m away from the receive pose recorded at the end of right_receive_and_brake.

phases.name: left_receive_and_brake
phases.text: the cube is on the left scoop (touched within the last 25 ms) and not on the right one (no right-scoop contact within the last 25 ms), for 0.3 s without interruption. During that time its centre is within 0.065 m of the left floor centre along both tool x and tool y, and it moves at less than 0.05 m/s relative to the left scoop.

phases.name: final_support_deposit
phases.text: the cube touches the output platform and has touched neither scoop within the last 25 ms, for 0.5 s without interruption. During that time its centre is within 0.065 m horizontally (a circle) of the platform's centre (the platform top is 0.20 x 0.15 m), and it moves slower than 0.04 m/s. This completes the task.

task_failures: tilt_only_shortcut: before final_support_deposit (during phases left_inertial_slip to left_receive_and_brake), either scoop's tool z axis tilts more than 2.1 deg away from world vertical.

airborne_transfer_shortcut: before final_support_deposit, the cube stays unsupported for more than 0.09 s at a stretch. Unsupported means it has touched neither scoop within the last 25 ms, so this fires after roughly 0.115 s without any scoop contact.
contact_rules: Each scoop (whole tool link, adapter included) may touch the cube only: not the output platform, not the table. No other part of either robot, the fingers included, may touch anything. The two arms and their scoops may never touch each other, and no arm may touch itself.
difficulty_note: With tilting forbidden and almost no friction, the cube can be moved only by changing the scoops' velocities. Each transfer is a level hand-off across the gap between two independently moving scoops, during which the cube may lose scoop contact for only about 0.1 s. The receiving scoop must then bring the cube to rest relative to itself, near its centre, and hold it there for 0.3 s.
standard_notes: Nothing moves at t = 0 except that the cube settles onto the left scoop. Because the surfaces are so slippery, any change in a scoop's velocity makes the cube slide on it; watch the cube's position on the scoop from frame to frame.
